lemmas.primary_translation: go through rough terrain / proceed carelessly or sloppily / be out of control

definitions.translation: go through rough terrain (lit. go over logs and stones)

examples.no: kjøreturen gikk over stokk og stein
examples.en: the drive went over hill and dale

definitions.text: gå uvørent eller slurvete for seg

examples.no: utviklingen har gått over stokk og stein i det siste
examples.en: developments have been running out of control lately
